scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: I can't move between time and dimensions like master Hugin but I can pretend to.

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: What's causing this Glast Heim to be imbued with such a powerful dark force?
I don't care
That is interesting, please tell me more

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: Thanks to Hugin, I found the way to access this Old Glast Heim, which is imbued by such powerful dark forces.

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: What do you say? Do you want to explore there?
No exploration for me
I really want to explore!

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: Sure, but this is not a free service! I have to get something in return. Hoho...

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: I can send you to two places. Which place would you like me to send you?
Cancel
Monastery Cemetery (Lv100~130) - 5000z
2nd floor Corridor (Over Lv140) - 10000z

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: Alright, please come back whenever you change your mind. I think you will have lots to talk with me about...

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: What? Did you expect this service for free?

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: Well, if you are not interested in it, never mind.

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text:
You want to return?
Ok, let's get out of here.
I didn't mean to talk to you
Please get me out of here

scripts.speaker: Hugin's Follower
scripts.text: Alright, just tell me whenever you want to leave.
